description: This script updates a README file with release information and manifest comparisons for a Raspberry Pi vendor project, fetching and parsing XML manifests from a remote URL.

methods.name: fetch_manifest_xml
methods.description: Fetches manifest XML from a remote URL based on manifest name and release tag.

methods.name: parse_manifest
methods.description: Parses the manifest XML to extract Yocto version and layer revisions.

methods.name: generate_table_single
methods.description: Generates a markdown table listing layers and their revisions.

methods.name: generate_table_compare
methods.description: Generates a markdown comparison table between two sets of layer revisions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling command-line arguments, fetching manifests, and updating the README file.
